# Synthetic combined-survey fixtures

All names, IDs, addresses and sources here are invented. These files contain no
real survey responses. `mucp-schema.json` and `mucp-responses.json` exercise the
public parser; `so2-workbook.json` supplies worksheet rows which tests convert
to XLSX in their temporary directory. `so2-findings.json` supplies frozen
resolution rows; tests bind it to the generated workbook hash before use.

Keep these fixtures small. Bulk-source, version and large-question-universe
cases remain generated by `tests/test_survey_mucp.py`.
